questions.prompt: What is the capital city of Finland?

hints.nudge: It starts with the letter H and has 8 letters.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Finland article.

questions.proof: The capital of Finland is Helsinki; the second largest city is Tampere.

questions.prompt: Which of these countries shares a border with Finland?

hints.nudge: It starts with the letter N and has 6 letters.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Finland article.

questions.proof: Its neighbours are Sweden to the west, Norway to the north, Russia to the east and Estonia to the south, beyond the sea called Gulf of Finland.

questions.prompt: Which language is an official language of Finland?

hints.nudge: It starts with the letter F and has 7 letters.

questions.proof: Finnish and Swedish both are the official languages of Finland; the most spoken languages is Finnish, mother tongue of about 90% of the population.

hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Finland article.

questions.proof: Finland (Finnish: Suomi) is a country in Northern Europe and is a member state of the European Union and NATO.
